summary: comments sweep: remove the unreachable pre-first-fetch budget guard and pin the real sweepBudget first-fetch contract in tests.
reason: A fresh sweepBudget starts at charged 0 with a floor estimate of 1, so allows() is true for every possible --max-credits before the first charge: the special-cased guard before the initial posts fetch could never fire, and TestSweepBudget_GatesTheFirstFetch asserted only constructor defaults while its comment claimed the opposite of its assertions. Found by the post-publish review of PR #1680's drive-to-green delta (dead code, zero runtime harm, misleading contract). The invariant is now documented on sweepBudget and pinned by TestSweepBudget_FreshBudgetAlwaysAdmitsTheFirstFetch; the reachable gates (comments fetch, posts page, breach halt) are proven end-to-end in amend_credit_contracts_test.go through the fake-client seam.
validated_outcome: publish validate pass; full unit suite green; no runtime behavior change (the removed branch was unreachable).
